parameters.content:
## Consilium Lite v1.0 (2026-07-18)
The DEFAULT instrument (operator decision after the 2026-07-17 cost audit, option C).
Deterministic core + 3 LLM calls (S1-slim, S2a spec, S2b-lite memo). ~$0.25-0.35/run.

NOT here, by design: Stage 3 sentiment, Stage 4 gate, Stage 5 auditor, Stage 6 arbiter, DI.
Replacement screen: the deterministic NUMBER_AUDIT banner at the top of every report.
Escalation rule: finalists, near-band-edge verdicts (see spine CLAUDE.md), or any report
with unmatched numbers in the banner -> run the FULL Consilium Spine on that ticker.

Shares the SAME microservice, credentials (by name) and env vars as the spine — zero new
setup. Import this file alongside consilium_spine; both can coexist in one n8n.
Verdict here = deterministic verdict_cap only (implied CAGR vs 12/16% bands). No prose
can override it, and nothing here weakens any spine gate — Lite simply does not run them.
